description: This file contains React functional components for UI elements, including Card, SectionHeader, StatusBadge, EmptyState, and LoadingSkeleton, used for building parts of a dashboard interface.

methods.name: Card
methods.description: A styled container component that wraps children elements with custom className support.

methods.name: SectionHeader
methods.description: A component that displays a header with a title, optional subtitle, and optional right-aligned content.

methods.name: StatusBadge
methods.description: A badge component that visually indicates the status (active, upcoming, completed, issue) with different labels and styles.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: Displays a placeholder message with a title and body, indicating an empty or default state.

methods.name: LoadingSkeleton
methods.description: A placeholder skeleton UI component rendered during loading states, with customizable number of lines.
